strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了吗？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Could you repeat that? I can’t hear{NEWLINE}you at all. A bad connection, I guess.{SCROLL}Please move along and call again!

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你最近在做什么？{SCROLL}当然是一如既往地{NEWLINE}锻炼我的水系精灵呀。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}What have you been up to lately?{SCROLL}Me? Training my Water-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, same as always, of course.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 整个地区有16个道馆,{NEWLINE}要把这16个道馆徽章{CLEAR}全部收入囊中可不是件易事。{CLEAR}你可要继续加油哦。
strings.en: There are 16 Gyms across the whole{NEWLINE}region, and collecting all 16 Badges is{CLEAR}no easy task. Keep at it, you hear?

strings.zh: 因为我现在是美少女馆主嘛,{NEWLINE}所以越来越忙了。{SCROLL}对了,星期三的早上{NEWLINE}还是蛮闲的,{CLEAR}到时候你可以打电话给我。
strings.en: Being a beautiful young Gym Leader{NEWLINE}keeps me busier and busier, you know.{SCROLL}Oh, but Wednesday mornings are{NEWLINE}pretty free. You can call me then.

strings.zh: 啊,今天我正好没事！{NEWLINE}再来和我对战场怎么样？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh hi, I’m free today!{NEWLINE}Let’s battle again, OK?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好的！{NEWLINE}那我在战斗前线的{CLEAR}训练家屋里等你！
strings.en: OK! Then I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 什么？{NEWLINE}你预约的只有我吗？{SCROLL}你不是还和其他人也有预约吗？
strings.en: What? Am I the only one you’ve{NEWLINE}made plans with?{SCROLL}Don’t you have plans with{NEWLINE}someone else too?
strings.notes: US 0650/8 | RV071: meaning: 什么？ is 'What?', not 'I'm not sure'

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你。{CLEAR}别放我鸽子。
strings.en: I’ll be waiting at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier.{CLEAR}Don’t you stand me up.
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我是小霞,{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Yes, this is Misty...{NEWLINE}Hi, how are you?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我不是说了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你来战斗吗？{CLEAR}你可千万别忘了！{CLEAR}我等你。
strings.en: Didn’t I say I’d be waiting for you{NEWLINE}to battle at the Trainer House{CLEAR}at the Battle Frontier? Don’t{CLEAR}you dare forget! I’m waiting.
strings.notes: US 0650/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 你关东地区都走遍了吗？{CLEAR}有去城都地区看看吗？{CLEAR}肯定有很多地方{CLEAR}景色不错吧！{SCROLL}我最喜欢２５号道路的海角！{SCROLL}我小时候就经常去那里玩,{NEWLINE}留下来很多美好的回忆啊！
strings.en: Have you been all over Kanto? Have{NEWLINE}you seen Johto too? I bet there are{CLEAR}loads of places with great views!{SCROLL}My favorite is the cape on Route 25!{SCROLL}I went there all the time{NEWLINE}when I was little. I have so{CLEAR}many good memories of it!

strings.zh: 我很怕常磐森林里的虫精灵,{NEWLINE}要不是你,我真的不知道{CLEAR}该怎么拿回丢在森林里的暴鲤龙。{SCROLL}那是爸爸托付给我的暴鲤龙,{NEWLINE}对我来说非常重要。{CLEAR}所以……{CLEAR}真的非常感谢你！
strings.en: I’m scared of the Bug Pokémon in{NEWLINE}Viridian Forest. If it weren’t for you,{CLEAR}I really wouldn’t have known how to{CLEAR}get back the Gyarados I lost in there.{SCROLL}That Gyarados was entrusted to{NEWLINE}me by my dad, so it means so much{CLEAR}to me. So... thank you, really!

strings.zh: 喂喂,你知道吗？{NEWLINE}听说完胜２５号道路的{CLEAR}５人组的话,{CLEAR}就能实现你恋爱的愿望！{SCROLL}你没听说过么？{NEWLINE}那是当然了,{SCROLL}因为这是我自己瞎掰的！
strings.en: Hey, did you know? They say if{NEWLINE}you beat all five Trainers on{CLEAR}Route 25 without losing once,{CLEAR}your wish for love will come true!{SCROLL}You’ve never heard{NEWLINE}of it? Of course not,{SCROLL}because I just made it up!
